title: 15% off your first order
description: New DoorDash users save 15% on their first order of $15 or more (up to $10 off) through September 30, 2026. Excludes taxes, fees, tip, and alcohol.

title: 30% off first grocery or retail order
description: Part of DoorDash's Saturday Streaks football sweepstakes: 30% off your first grocery or retail order of $35+ (up to $20 off), through September 30, 2026.

title: DashPass: free 30-day trial, $0 delivery fees
description: DashPass members get $0 delivery fees on eligible orders plus 5% back on pickup orders. New members start with a free 30-day trial.

title: $10 off your first order of $20+
description: New Uber Eats customers can save $10 on a first order of $20 or more. Valid September 1-30, 2026; limited redemptions.

title: Uber One: $0 delivery fees + up to 10% off
description: Uber One membership at $9.99/month or $96/year includes $0 delivery fees on eligible food and grocery orders, up to 10% off deliveries and pickup, and 6% Uber Cash back on eligible rides.

title: Save up to 60% on your first 2 orders
description: New-user bundle deal offering up to 60% off the first two Uber Eats orders, advertised in current September 2026 coupon listings.

title: 20% off your online order
description: Domino's posts rotating online-only coupons at dominos.com - recent offers include 20% off regular-priced items on online orders. Availability varies by location.

title: 2+ large 2-topping pizzas for $12.99 each
description: Order two or more large 2-topping pizzas at $12.99 each through current online offers at dominos.com. Participating locations only.

title: Piece of the Pie Rewards: earn points toward free pizza
description: Domino's loyalty program awards points on every order of $5 or more; points convert into free pizzas and sides. Free to join and ongoing.

title: 30% off $39+ orders for new users
description: Temu frequently runs new-customer promos like 30% off orders over $39. Check temu.com at checkout for the current offer.

title: Up to 10% off your order
description: Temu's promo rotation regularly includes percentage-off offers. Look for the current coupon at checkout; eligibility varies by account.

title: Free shipping on almost all orders
description: Temu offers free shipping on nearly all orders sitewide with no minimum spend on most items, plus price-adjustment refunds if a purchased item drops in price shortly after.

title: Up to 90% off Lightning Deals
description: Temu runs rotating flash and Lightning Deal events with discounts of up to 90% across fashion, home, electronics, and more.

title: Sale: Up to 50% Off
description: Hundreds of shoes, apparel and accessories marked down up to 50%, with deepest cuts on Tech Fleece and Air Max Dn8. No code needed and free shipping for Nike Members.

title: Last Chance Clearance: Up to 50% Off
description: Nike's deep-clearance rail with end-of-season and discontinued styles priced to move, discounts already applied at list price. Stock is limited and popular sizes sell out fast.

title: 10% Off for Students, Military & First Responders
description: Eligible students, military members, veterans and first responders get 10% off every order year-round after verifying their status on nike.com.

title: Fall Kick Off Sale: Up to 60% Off
description: The Fall Kick Off Sale takes up to 60% off shoes, apparel and accessories at adidas.com; watch for extra-savings promo offers during the event.

title: Free Shipping for adiClub Members
description: adidas adiClub members get free shipping on all orders with no minimum. Membership is free to join.

title: Sale Section: Up to 60% Off Beauty
description: Marked-down products across haircare, makeup, skincare, fragrance and styling tools with no promo code required. Haircare has the most deals, with makeup discounts reaching 50% on brands like Fenty Beauty and ILIA.

title: Free Standard Shipping: Beauty Insider Always, Guests on $50+
description: Beauty Insider members get free standard shipping on every order with no minimum; guest checkout gets free shipping on orders of $50 or more.

title: Auto-Replenish: 5% Off Every Order, Up to 30%
description: Schedule recurring deliveries of makeup, skincare and fragrance to save 5% automatically with free shipping; select brands offer up to 30% off on your first three orders. Beauty Insider members only.

title: 15% Off Fragrance
description: Save 15% on fragrance with this official Ulta coupon, redeemable online, in the app or shown in store. Excludes Chanel; ends tonight at 11:59pm CT on September 28, 2026.

title: Brow Sale: Up to 50% Off
description: Up to 50% off brow products from Morphe, Tarte, Revlon, CoverGirl, Grande Cosmetics and RMS Beauty, from about $4 brow pencils to GrandeBROW serum. Several picks include a free gift with purchase; valid through October 3.

title: 10% Off When You Sign Up for Text Alerts
description: Get a one-time-use 10% off code by signing up for Ulta text alerts. Note: only one coupon code can be used per order at checkout.

title: 20% Off Orders $50+
description: Shein regularly posts sitewide promo events; recent offers include 20% off purchases of $50 or more. Check shein.com for today's offer.

title: 15% Off Your Next Purchase
description: Shein's promo calendar often includes percentage-off events for shoppers - see the current offer on shein.com.

title: Up to 50% Off 300K+ Top Sellers
description: Shop over 300,000 top-selling Shein products at up to 50% off during sale events on shein.com.

title: Up to 60% Off 48-Hour Flash Sale
description: Short 48-hour flash sale with up to 60% off select electronics and appliances. Ends today, September 28, 2026.

title: 30% Off or More on Member Deals
description: Best Buy members get 30% off or more on featured member-exclusive pricing across tech and appliances, rotating through the season.

title: Free $5 Gift Card with Orders Over $420
description: Spend $420 or more in one order and get a free $5 Best Buy gift card. Only a few days left on this reward offer.

title: Circle Deal Days: Up to 40% Off
description: Target's official two-day member event runs Oct 6-7, 2026 with up to 40% off thousands of items in fashion, beauty, home, toys and tech (Circle 360 early access Oct 5). Free Target Circle membership required.

title: 15% Off First Purchase for New Circle Members
description: Guests who join Target Circle between Sept 27 and Oct 5, 2026 receive 15% off their first purchase, per Target's official announcement.

title: Free Shipping on $35+ Orders
description: Most online orders of $35 or more ship free from Target, no membership needed.

title: New customers: $10 off $35+ pickup or delivery
description: New Walmart customers can get $10 off orders of $35 or more via pickup or delivery across their first few eligible orders. Eligibility varies by account.

title: Walmart Photo: Extra 25% Off $20+ Orders
description: Score an extra 25% off sitewide at Walmart Photo when you spend $20 or more, plus $10 off orders of $50+ and 20% off select holiday cards.

title: Free 2-Day Shipping on $35+ Orders
description: Orders of $35 or more ship free with 2-day delivery on most items sold and shipped by Walmart.com.

title: 15% Off Select Handbags
description: Official eBay coupon: 15% off eligible handbags with no minimum purchase, capped at $500 off per transaction, max two redemptions per user. Valid Sept 24-30, 2026 for US/Canada eBay users; eligible listings show the code on the item page. Confirmed live on Sept 28, 2026.

title: 20% off select items (up to $350 off)
description: eBay runs rotating sitewide percentage-off coupons (recently 20% off select items, up to $350 off, two uses per customer). Watch for the current coupon on eligible listings.

title: eBay Daily Deals: Up to 60% Off
description: Rotating daily deals across electronics, fashion and home with savings up to 60% off, free shipping on many items.

title: Extra 30% Off Best of the Season Sale
description: Macy's Best of the Season Sale offers an extra 30% off most sale and regular-price items (15% off beauty, fragrances, watches and select designer jewelry). Base markdowns run as high as 77%. Ends Sept 29.

title: Up to 85% Off Fine Jewelry Sale
description: The Best of the Season fine jewelry event takes up to 85% off rings, necklaces, bracelets and earrings across diamond, gold, gemstone and pearl styles.

title: Free Shipping on Orders $39+ for Star Rewards
description: Star Rewards members (free to join) get free shipping on orders over $39; non-members get free shipping on orders over $49 or pay a $10.95 flat rate.

title: $20 Star Money for Every $100 Spent
description: During the Best of the Season Sale, Star Rewards members earn $20 in Star Money (2,000 bonus points) for every $100 spent on eligible brands.

title: Customer Appreciation Event: Extra 15-30% Off
description: Tiered extra savings on event selections: Kohl's Card holders take an extra 30% off, Kohl's Rewards members an extra 20% off, and nonmembers an extra 15% off.

title: Redeem Kohl's Cash Sept 28 - Oct 4
description: Shoppers who earned $10 Kohl's Cash for every $50 spent through Sept 27 can redeem it on purchases from Sept 28 through Oct 4.

title: $10 Off $50+ Toys for Rewards Members
description: Kohl's Rewards members get $10 off a $50 toy purchase (rare savings on Disney, LEGO and more) through Oct 4 - a good window to stock the gift closet.

title: Free Shipping on Orders $49+
description: Get free shipping on Kohl's orders of $49 or more; orders under the threshold ship from $8.95, and free in-store pickup is available on most items.

title: $20 eGift Card on First $49+ Order
description: New Chewy customers who check out with a qualifying first order of $49 or more can receive a $20 eGift Card by email for a future purchase.

title: $5 Off First Chewy App Order
description: Download the Chewy app, sign in or create an account, and look for the $5 off first-app-order promo at checkout.

title: 20% Off First Pharmacy Order
description: Chewy Pharmacy promotions include 20% off (up to $30 off) a first prescription order. Ends Sept 30.

title: 35% Off First Autoship + 5% Off Future Orders
description: Turn on Autoship at checkout and save 35% (up to $20) on your first delivery, then 5% off every future scheduled delivery. No code needed; pause or cancel anytime.

title: Free 1-3 Day Shipping on Orders $49+
description: Chewy automatically applies free 1-3 day shipping on orders of $49 or more; orders under that total ship for a flat $4.95.

title: Up to 70% Off Furniture & Home Deals
description: Wayfair's fall clearance takes up to 70% off furniture, decor, lighting, kitchen and outdoor items sitewide, with new deals added throughout September.

title: Free Shipping on Orders Over $35
description: Wayfair ships most orders over $35 free to your door; orders under $35 pay a flat $4.99 shipping fee.

title: App-Exclusive Savings & Deal Alerts
description: Shopping the Wayfair app unlocks app-only price drops, flash deals and early access to sale events not shown on the desktop site.

title: Up to 50% Off Fall Decor & Renovation
description: Home Depot's fall event takes up to 50% off home decor, lighting, vanities and flooring to refresh rooms ahead of the holidays.

title: 10% Military Discount
description: Active-duty military, veterans and their dependents get 10% off eligible purchases year-round by verifying military status in their Home Depot account.

title: Up to 40% Off Tools - Special Buys
description: Special Buy of the Day and rotating promos take up to 40% off power tools, hand tools and tool storage from brands like Ryobi, DEWALT and Milwaukee.

title: Free Delivery on Orders $45+
description: Home Depot offers free delivery on most orders over $45; orders under $45 pay standard delivery fees by item and distance.
